verdict: NOT SOLID - multiple failure modes; a positive '375 pathways (44 novel)' framing is unsupported

findings.375_is_real_data: 375 comes from source=real_grqa_data (real GRQA parquet), NOT synthetic. So the count is not from a synthetic run.
findings.validation: total_validated=0, validation_rate=0.0 for all 375. Zero chains matched the known-chain set.
findings.novel_44_is_circular_label: 'novel_chains' is DEFINED as validated_count==0 AND appears in >20% of sites AND freq>=3. 'Novel' literally means 'did not match a known chain' = a residual/unmatched bucket, not a discovery.
findings.method_not_pcmci: Docstrings claim PCMCI. Actual method (_test_granger_causality/_partial_correlation) is bivariate lagged partial correlation controlling only for the effect's own lag-1 term. Not multivariate PCMCI+, no confounder conditioning set, no FDR control across the ~thousands of pairwise*lag tests.
findings.validation_impossible_by_construction: Real run loaded ONLY sensor-modality params (all mapped to modality='sensor'). Of 15 known validation chains, only 2 are sensor->sensor; the other 13 require satellite/microbial/molecular/behavioral variables that were never loaded, so 13/15 known chains are unvalidatable by construction.
findings.reciprocal_directions: All 44 'novel' chains are reciprocal: both A->B and B->A appear as 'significant'. True directional causality cannot hold in both directions for every pair; confirms symmetric correlational lead-lags, not causal direction.
findings.no_fdr: significance_level=0.05 applied per-pair with no multiple-testing correction across ~11 vars * ~10 others * ~40 lags per site * 17 sites; 375 'significant' hits are expected under mass testing.

repo_docs_already_honest.README.md: lines 67,273,442 already state '0/375 validated', 'not PCMCI+', reported as proof-of-concept

honest_number: 375 lagged partial-correlation lead-lag screens on real GRQA sensor data, 0/375 validated against known environmental causal chains (validation_rate=0.0). NOT causal discovery, NOT PCMCI+, NOT 'novel causal pathways'. The '44 novel' are 44 unmatched (and reciprocally symmetric) correlational lead-lags.
failure_modes: STRAW-MAN/METHOD-MISLABEL (screening sold as PCMCI causal discovery)
leakage-adjacent: validation set unusable by construction (only sensor modality loaded)
